d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa Corporate Technology Support is transforming how operational support is delivered to our end users. As part of this evolution, we are aligning support functions into a single, service-focused organization dedicated to providing a consistent, responsive, and world-class technology experience.

The AV and Event Operations Specialist will play a key role in supporting audio-visual operations, live streaming, video production, and event delivery across Visa. This role supports the Senior Event Operations Specialist and the Lead, Events and Video Production Specialist to ensure events, meetings, broadcasts, and AV-enabled experiences are delivered smoothly, efficiently, and to a high standard.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role that requires technical versatility, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work calmly and effectively in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will help manage logistical details, provide on-site support, troubleshoot AV issues in real time, and contribute to continuous improvement across AV and event operations.
Exceptional Customer Service: Actively engage with end users, ensuring their issues and requests are addressed with professionalism, empathy, and efficiency.
Proactive Problem Solving: Identify issues before they escalate, using strong analytical and diagnostic skills to minimize downtime and ensure high-quality service delivery.
Technology Optimization: Continuously refine and improve support processes, adopt best practices, and seek opportunities to enhance the end-user computing environment.
q: Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Communications, Media Production, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in AV operations and event support.
Proven track record of supporting successful events and delivering high-quality results.
Experience with live streaming and video production is a plus.
Hands-on experience setting up, operating, and troubleshooting AV equipment, including cameras, microphones, lighting, projectors, displays, and related production technologies.
Experience supporting video conferencing, collaboration, and live streaming platforms such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, YouTube Live, Facebook Live, Twitch, or similar tools.
Understanding of media and streaming standards, including H.264, H.265, AAC, Dolby Digital, RTMP, HLS, DASH, HD, Full HD, and 4K.
Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and troubleshoot issues quickly in live event environments.
Ability to work calmly and professionally under pressure, manage time-sensitive tasks, and adapt to changing event requirements.
Experience coordinating with vendors, venues, internal teams, and stakeholders to support event logistics and delivery.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
